rubric.0: No defensible musical match in the available metadata, a non-music/insufficient-evidence record, or a hard constraint violation. Missing evidence is not proof of musical irrelevance.
rubric.1: Partial match: only part of a compound request, adjacent genre, generic genre without convincing seed/artist similarity, or conflicting dominant style.
rubric.2: Strong metadata support for the actual request: requested genre and mood where specified, or a compatible specific style/artist with playlist or positive-feedback context. No hard constraint may be violated.

interpretation: Read the literal request and all context, rather than treating every entry in the query's helper genres array as an equally sufficient alternative.
Alternative rock is a specific style; a generic rock or generic alternative tag alone is insufficient for full credit.
Hip-Hop/Rap and R&B/Soul are genuine composite catalog genre labels. Subgenres such as indie pop and Latin Pop count toward pop; jazz-hop is a partial jazz match and a strong hip-hop match.
A mood-only match is at most partial credit. Happy/dance/bubblegum evidence can support upbeat at lower confidence; mellow is not established merely by soul or R&B tags.

For artist similarity, the artist's own music is allowed because the request does not demand a different artist. A track credited to the requested artist also needs music evidence; an episode-like record tagged only Others is insufficient.

For playlist and feedback queries, assess each candidate against the real seed's catalog tags. Generic genre overlap alone usually earns 1. A mixed playlist permits compatibility with either seed; it does not demand that every song fuse both genres.

A disliked track is forbidden; less like a disliked seed is a soft similarity preference, not a ban on its whole genre or artist. Explicit excluded artists apply to all credited collaborators. Explicit excluded songs and previously supplied seeds must be checked by both ID and title/artist identity.

An isolated broad tag among contradictory dominant styles does not justify a strong label. Song titles, artist names embedded in other names, album names, and shared film titles do not establish genre or musical similarity.
All judgments use the frozen pooled metadata and catalog seed records, without audio or external music facts. They are AI judgments requiring independent human review, not human ground truth.

The pool had already been exposed with its original grades and aggregate metrics in this conversation. The re-review is not independent or fully blind. Per-system candidate ranks and scores are not used to choose the revised grades. After an initial reviewed-metrics calculation, the final evidence check reduced three trap-similarity labels because the actual 21 Savage seed has no trap tag. This amendment addresses unsupported seed inference, not optimization of a system result.
